author: FractalDataWorks
name: Reference authentication step
description: One step in an authentication flow: the step itself, its configuration, its Implementation and its MessageLogging. Referencing the package is what makes the step selectable — a flow naming a step whose package is absent fails at startup rather than quietly doing less.

Contributes.description: What this step produces. A step may only affect what it declares — the runner discards anything else and reports it.

choices.description: It resolves a subject to a local principal.
It gathers facts about a principal.
It decides whether a token may be issued.

Requires.description: What must already be established. Checked when the flow loads, so a misordered flow fails at boot naming what is missing.

choices.description: A local principal must already be resolved.

AuthenticationMethod.description: The RFC 8176 value the runner records if this step succeeds — pwd, otp, hwk, fpt. Leave empty for a step that proves nothing. Declare only what the step actually enforces: claiming more makes every downstream assurance check a lie.

EventIdBase.description: First EventId for this step's MessageLogging. Must not collide with an existing range.
